objective: makespan = latest end time over all jobs

release_time.description: Earliest time the job's first operation may start (0 = now)
release_time.label: job release time

step.description: Position of the operation in its job's route (1 = first)
step.label: routing step

machine.description: Machine that processes the operation; each job visits each machine once
machine.label: machine used

decision_variables.goes_first[machine, job, other_job]: binary, 1 if the job is processed on the machine before the other job (one per pair, job < other_job)

constraints.precedence[job, step]: the next step starts after this step ends; step 1 starts no earlier than the release time (bound)
constraints.makespan[job]: makespan >= end of the job's last step
constraints.order[machine, job, other_job]: big-M disjunction (M = horizon): one of each pair on a machine finishes before the other starts

goes_first.label: job pairs where the job goes first on the machine
